shared_elements: stylised hair/headdress rendered as a patterned block
justification: Both depict a human figure with an elaborated, block-like coiffure or headgear rendered as patterned masses, but that is essentially the only correspondence. A shows a narrative low-relief scene in strict profile with a bridled horse being led by a bearded man, while B is a frontal, three-dimensional standing figure covered with abstract discs, ovals and bands with no animal, no action and no profile convention.
